title: Optimal Quantization of Finite Uniform Data on the Sphere
summary: This paper develops a systematic and geometric theory of optimal quantization on the unit sphere $\mathbb S^2$, focusing on finite uniform probability distributions supported on the spherical surface - rather than on lower-dimensional geodesic subsets such as circles or arcs. We first establish the existence of optimal sets of $n$-means and characterize them through centroidal spherical Voronoi tessellations. Three fundamental structural results are obtained.
